g.text: Scale tier LLD — contracts on Postgres and Valkey
PRODUCTION SCALE TIER · interview design · ADR-0010, 0011, 0013, 0014 · the deployed demo tier keeps the same contracts on DynamoDB (ADR-0015)
job_events (job_id, seq, type, payload, at) pk (job_id, seq)
outbox (id, job_id, dispatched_at) -- only after SQS trigger
-- demo tier: same contracts as DynamoDB items (ADR-0015)
accept = one txn: key + job + event #1 · key reuse, new hash ⇒ 409
completed = verified final bytes + all evidence + policy
lock:memo:{same suffix} SET NX PX single-flight per snapshot
rl:{customer_id}:{window} fail-safe if Valkey is lost
quotas live in Postgres · losing Valkey loses no job
POST _aliases # one atomic call; polls _count first
browser holds only an HttpOnly session cookie;
the BFF forwards the access token server-side
POST /analyze · own jobs: read, events, cancel
SWITCH-OVER GATES · nothing is enabled until its gate passes (ADR-0009 amendment, ADR-0011)
